description: IWM-specific parameters - conservative small-cap with selective covered calls

covered_calls._comment_expiration: 14 DTE = 336h term. Retained after measurement: shortening to 4 DTE was tested and is materially WORSE - call median hold collapsed 24.0h -> 1.0h and return fell 37.74% -> 21.90%, because a near-dated call is bought straight back (approaching_strike fires almost immediately and the thin premium fails the call_min_premium_pct gate). A longer tenor is what makes the premium worth collecting at all.

exit_logic._comment_backstop: atr_stop_replaces_hard_stop=true: the ~k*ATR stop is the real risk floor; stop_loss_threshold (-5%) is a catastrophe backstop that effectively never fires behind the fast-exit stack. Behavior-neutral flag that makes the intent explicit and silences the inert-stop warning (bots #231).

entry_filters._comment_confirmation: Walk-forward validated (4x 180d windows, 2024-09..2026-09): loosening the confirmation band (atr_multiplier 0.2->0.1, pct_floor 0.0008->0.0005) improved return in 4/4 windows (median +0.71pp/window) with max-drawdown unchanged (median -0.06pp). Confirmation latency, not crossover TTL, is the binding constraint on the ETF class - the same loosening did NOT help the stock class (NVDA 1/4), so stock configs are left unchanged.
entry_filters._comment_ttl: crossover_expiration_seconds 28800 (8h) set for cross-symbol consistency with nvda.json (2026-10-12). Measured NEUTRAL for IWM: the ETF class converts almost no candidates regardless of TTL (2y replay: 411 candidates -> 5-6 fills at 1h and at 8h; return/DD unchanged to within a rounding error). The binding ETF constraint remains confirmation latency + the queue->fill path, per _comment_confirmation above.

threshold_coordination._comment_cc_horizon: max_hold_hours 144h = 42.9% of the 14-DTE (336h) term, above the 25% (84h) monetization floor, so the load-time check judges the CAP and passes: max(144,24)=144h >= 84h. cc_expected_position_hold_hours is 24h - the MEASURED median hold, not the cap - so the declaration describes real behaviour instead of the best case. Both facts are reported deliberately: the cap says how long the position MAY be held, the expected value says how long it actually is.

orchestrator._comment_cc_min_hold: Churn-exit deferral floor. 96h, NOT 24h: measured, a 24h floor lets churn exits back in almost immediately and 30/37 calls close in under 6h, which destroys the overlay. At 96h the median call hold is 24h with only 8/36 under 6h. Defers profit_target / trailing_stop / intraday_peak_giveback_shield / break_even_lock_exit / partial_scale_out while a call is open. Hard risk controls (emergency, stop_loss, atr_stop, overnight_gap, regime_flip, sma_slope) and the terminal time exits are never deferred. Effect: PF 0.96 -> 1.07, max drawdown 18.85% -> 8.65%.
orchestrator._comment: Valid postures: SURFACE_ALL, AUTO, TREND_MOMENTUM_GROWTH, VOLATILITY_DEFENSIVE, NEUTRAL_RANGE_HARVEST. Covered-call mode comes ONLY from cc_mode (#202) — COVERED_CALL_INCOME is no longer a valid strategy_intent.
